svg.title: The ladder of degradation
svg.desc: Six-row degradation ladder, dark theme. Primary model unavailable: fallback model classifies still works, losing some accuracy. Both models unavailable: deterministic backstop still works, losing nuance; unambiguous cases still caught. Total inference outage: evaluation queues for retry still works, losing immediacy, not coverage. Worker unavailable: gateway session persists still works, losing interaction handling until it returns. Gateway disconnect: worker still serves interactions still works, losing live evaluation until session resumes. Both unavailable: evidence and ladders intact in the database still works, losing live moderation until restored. The highlighted third row is the load-bearing one: a total inference outage costs immediacy rather than coverage. Contrast computed from hex: text 15.60 to 1, accent 8.31 to 1. No animation, no thresholds.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Each failure is survivable by the layer beneath it. An inference outage costs immediacy, not coverage.
